summary: P2 (Command Centre deep-links) end-to-end browser verification against previewqa on the preview URL. Seeded/aged data for all four record-specific deep-link kinds (draft_stale, rams_incomplete, compliance_expiring, coshh_review_due), navigated to each actionRoute both directly and via the Command Centre 'Attention Required' list, and validated hydration + tab/step selection + auto-open of the target wizard/modal. ALL FOUR SPECIFIC-RECORD DEEP-LINKS PASS end-to-end. SA route sanity PASS. Command Centre attention list correctly renders all 4 items with correct action buttons. The P1.4 RAMS-resume regression called out in iteration_41 is now RESOLVED for previewqa — all five distinctive fields hydrate and the 'Draft restored' toast fires.
critical_code_review_comments: P2.B (sa_deadline): today is 12 Sep 2026 — 141 days from 31 Jan 2027. sa_deadline never fires in this window so this branch is only verified by direct navigation (/app/self-assessment-prep loads and renders the dedicated Self Assessment Prep page, h1='Self Assessment Prep'). Backend regression test uses pytest.skip when out-of-window (see test_p2_sa_deadline_route_points_to_self_assessment_prep). Consider a feature-flagged unit test that stubs the date for permanent coverage.

GenericToolPage.jsx:250 toast.success('Draft restored') fires but Sonner default duration is 4s. The toast disappears before a browser test that waits 4.5s asserts on it. Rams.jsx toast fires reliably (also captured in this run). Not a bug, just a testing-friendliness note.

Both Rams.jsx and GenericToolPage.jsx call clearDraftQueryParam() after hydration — this is the desired behaviour but means end-URL assertions on ?draft=<id> will always fail post-hydration. Backend regression test test_p2_draft_stale_resume_route_carries_toolId_and_draft_id correctly asserts the SHAPE emitted by /api/attention, not the post-hydration URL. All good — just call this out so future testers do not treat the missing query string as a defect.

P2.E specific-record V2 deep-links smoke test — previewqa has zero jobs/invoices/quotes/POs/etc, so none of the V2 attention kinds (invoice_overdue, variation_awaiting, afp_overdue, quote_expiring, po_late, contract_expiring, snag_overdue, incident_open_high_priority, risk_assessment_review_due, team_cert_expiring) fired. Backend blanket test (test_p2_all_actionable_routes_target_specific_context) already guards the shape rule for every emitted kind; iteration_41 admin dataset also has thin data. To gain full smoke coverage, seed one row per module OR run this smoke pass against a heavily-populated demo account.
